What You Need to Apply

Make sure you have these documents and meet the eligibility requirements

Required Documents

  • Valid passport (6+ months validity)
  • Digital passport-style photo
  • Valid email address
  • Credit/debit card for payment
  • U.S. contact information (hotel/address)

Eligibility

  • Citizen of Visa Waiver Program country
  • Traveling for tourism or business (90 days or less)
  • Have not been denied U.S. visa previously
  • Hold a valid e-passport (biometric passport)
